title: FlexiSpot E1 Standing Desk with 100×60×1.8cm Particle Board Desktop: Black $169.99, White $199.99 Delivered @ FlexiSpot
body:

[GreenGuava] @froddoog: It was fixed by the rep soon after my comment. See below
https://www.ozbargain.com.au/comment/17775786/redir
[Lizard Spock] E1+10060 product discount
